project: MC3 first visible frame - deterministic budget gate
overview: Expose the existing runtime dispatch budget through the probe so identical experiments can stop by work performed instead of wall-clock time.
goals: Add an opt-in deterministic budget mode without changing default behavior.
Record proof of budget termination and reject timeout-based deterministic runs.
Prepare an honest N=10 acceptance run before graphics work resumes.
nonGoals: Do not edit runtime C++, generated code, provider, assets, FMV, semaphores or executables.
Do not run the native runner or PCSX2 in this story.
rules: Default behavior with MC3_DETERMINISTIC absent or zero must remain unchanged.
A deterministic run is invalid unless its raw trace contains dispatch-budget-reached and contains no timeout reached.
gif>0 or gsw>0 remains the only visual signal.
Every terminal command must be prefixed with rtk or rtk proxy.
Do not modify files outside allowedPaths.
qualityGates: Read docs/PROBE_NONDETERMINISM_ROOT_CAUSE.md and the three owned scripts before editing.
Parse every edited PowerShell script with zero parser errors.
Add synthetic tests for gate-off compatibility, missing/invalid budget rejection, budget marker acceptance, and timeout rejection without launching the runner.

stories.title: Wire deterministic dispatch budget into probes
stories.description: As Cloud's cheap implementation agent, expose and validate the existing MC3_DISPATCH_BUDGET so the coordinator can run an honest N=10 gate before attempting graphics fixes.
acceptanceCriteria: 14_run_boot_trace.bat preserves current behavior when MC3_DETERMINISTIC is absent/0; when it is 1, reject missing, nonnumeric or zero MC3_DISPATCH_BUDGET before launching anything.
The deterministic environment and positive budget are inherited by mc3_partial.exe and logged without changing runtime code.
Boot-Probe status records deterministic mode, budget, whether dispatch-budget-reached was observed, and whether the driver timed out.
Probe-Repeat records those fields per run and exits nonzero if any deterministic row lacks the budget marker or contains timeout reached.
Existing classification contract remains intact: true render requires render-started plus GIF/GSW; contradictions still fail.
Synthetic tests cover both valid and invalid deterministic evidence without launching the runner or altering latest_status.md.
The report gives the exact parent calibration and N=10 commands, rollback, expected exit meanings, and states that A2 itself creates no visual frame.
